apiAuthority.connection: Original authenticatedUrl/authentication; private URL/port/cookie not public
apiAuthority.cordis: Published internal/plugin(fiber), internal/status(fiber,oldState), Fiber.parent/ctx/name/uid/state/await and Context.get/provide/on/effect; no private registry or wrapping
apiAuthority.loader: Published EntryOptions.inject/disabled, Entry.options/fiber/disabled and EntryTree.entries(); fixture ordering only
apiAuthority.webServer: Published host/assigned port; route absence uses native HTTP fallback, never private prefixes

diagnosisQualification: Only lossy original failure protocol established; no concrete installed-product predicate/cause or peer-resolution mismatch verified. Root conclusions are the selection itself; no separate report exists.

controls: Original HTTPResponse complete headers with withheld declared one-byte body must raise source-owned timeout
Followed by successful original HTTPResponse one-byte body read
Timer/handler and first-failure identity preserved after both; original sockets closed
httpDeadlineRegression.position: After root GO/public pins/build proof, before case setup/CLI start
httpDeadlineRegression.qualification: Source-only until selected once positive driver; no slow-host/network reproduction or universal OS timing guarantee.

httpTotalDeadline.absoluteEnd: min(original shared RPC deadline, monotonic()+2); consumes existing case/family deadlines
httpTotalDeadline.mechanism: Owning main-process one-shot ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM around one retained exchange; no thread/process/second endpoint
httpTotalDeadline.qualification: Timely supported process-local interruption; no instant cancellation or universal OS timing guarantee.
httpTotalDeadline.stableFailureLatch: Source-owned HTTPDeadline without error payload; only real Transport timeout boundary latches first failure. Expected probe timeout never resets or alters first failure.

opaqueBoundary: No canonical changes, protected CODE/capture/finish semantic inspection or private content exposure.

readinessFailureProtocol.publicMapping: EXECUTOR_READY_STAGE_<explicit stage> in the existing failureCode field; no new public case-result field
readinessFailureProtocol.qualification: First unfinished original public check only; publication can fail and no installed-product cause is proved.

stages.ENT: Original Loader entry lookup and package name
stages.LAF: Exact selected new database/setup leaves absent
stages.REP: Readiness has not previously been published

rootPublication.binding: Retained original prepare return plan digest+monotonic deadline; no reset if current plan drifts
rootPublication.qualification: Supported-tool denial/unavailability or late/missing record remains FAILED_HOLD/uncertain; final publication original return and proof-write timing still require root retention.
